lines.text: Google's AI wants to turn your day into a storybook. And it just landed in India.
It's called Dreambeans, and India is its first country outside the US.
Myth number one: you have to type a prompt.
Fact: no prompt needed. It builds illustrated stories from Google apps you choose to connect, like Gmail, Calendar and Photos.
Some stories even come to life as short animations made with Veo.
Myth number two: it mixes languages, like Hinglish.
Fact: it speaks 14 languages, English plus 13 Indian languages like Hindi, Tamil and Bengali. But only one at a time.
It's free on Android and iOS, for adults 18 and over. Your stories are private, and you can delete your data anytime.
Google warns it can still get things wrong. Would you let AI write your day?
